name: NBA Live Court
author: ant456
description: An arcade-style NBA show with three modes: live games (an LED arena scoreboard with clock, quarter and records, quarter scores, a flame on scoring runs, player cards with ESPN headshots and rarity frames, bursts for big runs and late lead changes), recently finished games (final score plus the same stat cards), and upcoming games (matchup, records, tip-off and spread). Pick favorite teams and switch on the favorites lock to show only their games in every mode. ESPN's public scoreboard, no API key.

versions.notes: RGBIC support: effects now use a light's sections (a comet runs along it, fireworks pop on single sections, burst swaps alternating sections, glow fills up). Section counts are set in the Govee Lights portal. Home Assistant lights restore the scene they were playing.

Govee effects can now be set up in the Govee Lights portal: one shared settings file for every sports plugin, with per-sport overrides, re-read whenever it changes. The plugin's own govee block still works without the portal. Lights are restored reliably (verified and retried), and only one effect plays at a time across plugins.
Optional Govee light effects in the scoring team's colours (LAN or Home Assistant): burst, flash, pulse, chase, strobe, fireworks and glow, with the lights restored afterwards.
The hardwood court is replaced by an LED arena scoreboard like NHL Live Ice: red game clock, amber quarter, each team's record, and a gold lamp with the points of a 6+ point scoring run.

First release. Live, recent and upcoming NBA games in the retro-arcade style of NFL Live Field: court screen with quarter-by-quarter scores, CLUTCH warning and a flame on 8+ point runs; player cards for each game's points, rebounds and assists leaders (a player leading several categories is one card, with double-double / triple-double badges); bursts for big runs and fourth-quarter lead changes; favorites lock, spoiler delay and exclude list. Fetches ESPN one day at a time (yesterday, today, tomorrow in US Eastern) because ESPN rejects date ranges.

api_requirements.name: ESPN API
api_requirements.description: ESPN's public NBA scoreboard (scores, period and clock, quarter scores, records, spread and per-team leaders) and ESPN player headshots. One request per day asked for (yesterday, today, tomorrow). No API key.
